The workstation occupies the lower-right edge, with the organised office providing depth behind it. Focus rests on the manager's face.

The manager stands upright beside the workstation, facing right toward the offscreen visitor, with the face readable in three-quarter view. Both empty hands rest loosely at waist level. frame.light: Soft directional daylight from camera left shapes the face, balanced by gentle interior fill. Display reflections remain controlled. Warm, natural colour and subtle optical imperfections give the image a photorealistic corporate-film finish.

video.situation: Daytime in the hotel operations office, just after the welcome and introduction to standalone AI tools. The manager continues the explanation to the visitor standing offscreen right.
video.people: The Company B Operations Manager stands frame left beside the workstation, wearing a warm taupe tailored jacket and ivory blouse. flow.text: For the opening moment, the manager keeps lips closed and eyes on the offscreen visitor. The upright posture and relaxed hands remain unchanged.

flow.to: Company A Operations Manager, offscreen right

flow.listener: The visitor listens offscreen without speaking.

flow.text: The manager closes the lips after the explanation and keeps the chin level. Hold the visitor's eyeline through the end of the six-second shot, with hands still resting loosely at waist level.
